newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-El Paso mulls Tenneco Australia options.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-El Paso mulls Tenneco Australia options.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp said on Thursday it was considering options for the future of the Australian operations of Tenneco Inc's Tenneco Energy unit.
El Paso and Tenneco Energy have agreed to merge.

El Paso Energy International Co president and chief executive John Hushon said the company was considering several options to share equity ownership of Tenneco Energy Australia's assets with Australian and/or U.S. financial and strategic investors.
Hushon said in statement issued in Australia that El Paso had made arrangements for the project financing of Tenneco Energy Australia's assets in Australia with Deutsche Bank.
"Closing of these arrangements is conditioned upon the El Paso/Tenneco Energy merger going forward and is expected to take place in December," Hushon said.

Tenneco Energy Australia said in the same statement although the future corporate structure of Tenneco Energy Australia under the ownership of El Paso is yet to be confirmed, the company will retain its operational and developmental presence here.
On Tuesday, Australian Gas Light Co (AGL) managing director Len Bleasel said AGL was interested in looking at Tenneco's Australian assets if they were put up for sale.
